# Encodian - Excel: Excel - Separate Worksheets

Separates worksheets into individual files in Encodian - Excel.

```
PUT https://connect.mindcloud.co/v1/universal/encodianExcel/latest/actions/excel-separate-worksheets
```

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer $MINDCLOUD_API_KEY` and pass a Encodian - Excel `connectionId` ([setup](../authentication.md)).

## Example request

```bash
curl -X PUT "https://connect.mindcloud.co/v1/universal/encodianExcel/latest/actions/excel-separate-worksheets" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MINDCLOUD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "connectionId": "$CONNECTION_ID",
  "fileContent": ""
}'
```

```js
const response = await fetch('https://connect.mindcloud.co/v1/universal/encodianExcel/latest/actions/excel-separate-worksheets', {
  method: 'PUT',
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.MINDCLOUD_API_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    connectionId,
    "fileContent": ""
  })
});

const { success, data } = await response.json();
```

## Inputs

Arguments are sent as JSON body fields ([conventions](../arguments.md)).

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fileContent` | file | yes | Default: ``. |

### Advanced

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cultureName` | string | no | Default: `en-US`. |

## Native endpoint

Through the native Encodian - Excel API, this operation is `POST /api/v1/Excel/ExcelSeparateWorksheets` (base URL `https://api.apps-encodian.com`). The Universal API call above is translated to it by MindCloud, including authentication. See the [native action reference](../../native-api/actions/excel-separate-worksheets.md) for the provider-specific parameters and requirements.
